systems.system: Automated system generating the numéro d'identification national unique (NIN)
systems.owner: minister in charge of the interior
systems.tiers: central; to be in place by 31 December 2023 under decree 23-316; the 18-digit NIN is built from the year, commune or country code, act number and register series of the birth entry, and is carried on civil-status registers and extracts held at communes and consular services
named only as a system the national vehicle registration file is linked to (decree 23-317, art. 5)

systems.system: Link between the national vehicle registration file and the national automated civil-status register
systems.owner: minister in charge of the interior

systems.system: Interoperability link between authorised entities' information systems and the NIN automated system
systems.owner: minister in charge of the interior
systems.tiers: national; holders of biometric documents are dispensed from presenting papers obtainable through it (decree 23-316, arts. 8 and 9)

note: The gazette carries the NIN decree and the vehicle registration file decree; the NIN is derived from the birth entry and written on civil-status registers, but the text says nothing on how the commune office makes the birth or death record.
